uncited: Vertex Clustering simplifies a mesh by dividing the object's bounding box into a regular grid of cells and merging all vertices falling within each cell into a single representative vertex.
*   **Grid Resolution:** Controls the level of detail.
Typical values depend on the dataset size and target memory budget.
*   **Topology Preservation:** Standard vertex clustering can alter topology (e.g., merging distinct components).
